metadata.title: Netflix Acquires Ben Affleck’s AI Filmmaking Company InterPositive with Affleck as Adviser

left: 1- Netflix announced it is acquiring InterPositive, a filmmaking technology company founded in 2022 by actor Ben Affleck. 2-The move reflects Netflix’s strategy to expand the use of generative AI in filmmaking, building on its earlier use of AI for certain visual effects in original productions. 3- InterPositive develops AI tools designed to assist film production teams in post-production tasks—such as fixing continuity issues or adjusting lighting—while focusing on supporting human creativity rather than replacing actors with synthetic performances.
